_note: ST-02/ST-03 canonical VOLATILE-state map (roadmap parity-evidence §7). Groups the once-per-frame flow-trace STATE-VA fields (the fields tools/flow/retail_fields.json declares for the 4 STATE_VAS the v3 game-state panel captures) into a named SUBSYSTEM TREE, so a divergent volatile field at a logical frame resolves to (subsystem, field) — the class-2 (volatile-deterministic) analogue of state-map-v1.json's persistent arena regions. This file is the R3 GROUPING; each field's va+TYPE is resolved from retail_fields.json (the single source of truth — NOT transcribed here, so it can't drift; a schema field absent there is a fail-closed error). Consumed by tools/parity/state_codec.py (encoder) + state_merkle.py (Merkle roots) + state_producer.py (the `state` pillar). Prose model + the 4 state CLASSES: docs/reference/canonical-state.md. A field marked benign (with reason) is EXCLUDED from the tree/root (never silently — an explicit exception, mirroring retail_fields.json's own benign marks). Extend as ST-06 expands scene coverage; never invent a field whose meaning is unknown.

state_vas.0x47be92: tick_scheduler  — rng (LCG state DAT_006023a0) + rngcalls (cumulative draws): the frame-determinism root
state_vas.0x48670f: house_update    — HOUSE free-roam actors/phase/interaction/customer-service (fires when cc08 arm is free-roam)
state_vas.0x46c320: dialogue_tick   — opening-prologue dialogue reveal + standee tween

policy.float: f32 fields compared by BIT PATTERN (the project's x87-invariant rule) — no epsilon. Values arrive already collapsed to their f32 by orv3_state._norm_f32 (retail Frida widens an f32 to a double; the port C-printf rounds it — the SAME f32), so pack('<f') round-trips both to identical 4 bytes.
policy.int: i32/u32/hex compared by the 32-bit VALUE: encoded pack('<I', v & 0xFFFFFFFF), so a signed-vs-unsigned repr mismatch across the two capture paths (Frida i32 read vs port emit) can never read as a divergence when the 32 bits match — the same defence _norm_f32 gives floats.
policy.coverage: a field/subsystem present in one frame's capture but not the other's is a REAL present/absent divergence (a scene arm that ran on one side only), NOT masked. A subsystem symmetrically absent (e.g. house_update dark during a tutorial dialogue stretch on BOTH sides) is simply not compared that frame.
policy.benign: a field in the `benign` list is dropped from the tree BEFORE hashing (its change cannot alter a subsystem/root hash), with a recorded reason — the volatile analogue of state-map-v1.json excluded bytes. The only v1 exclusion is title/submenu_state (engine-quirk §102).

rng.note: the raw LCG state DAT_006023a0 — THE deterministic RNG value. Matching it frame-over-frame is a STRONGER proof than a cumulative counter: equal state at every frame boundary ⇒ identical consumption between boundaries. (rngcalls is benign-excluded — see below.)

phase.note: frame-phase counters ({phasepin} zeroes db054's intro-video-freeze origin; unpinned they read a CONST-OFFSET the pillar rightly FAILS until a pin normalizes it).

player.note: player actor 0 world pos + facing octant/angle + anim cell/frame/counter.

companion.note: companion actor 2 pos/facing/anim + FUN_0048a833 controller mode/gate/wander state.

shop_npc.note: in-shop browsing chibi-NPC slot 0 anim + the pump frame/spawn counters + the 6 shop-window bg-NPC drift X (bgnpc warmup).

interaction.note: the INGAME interaction state machine (cc08/cc04) + highlighted display cell + context-menu cursor/count + display-management + the modal-cursor flag + active save-slot.

customer_service.note: the cc08==4 customer-service/haggle machine: sub-state, transaction type, kyaku index, offer/ask/base prices, round/patience, leave phase, scripted-machine PC/gate, poses, reaction timers.

camera.note: the 3D camera eye + lookat (XYZ each) — the eye/lookat pair sets pitch/angle.

dust_fx.note: the records_a_dust particle aggregate (count/age + spawn pos/vel) — sim-driven FX state.

dialogue_house.note: the in-HOUSE dialogue gate + iv2 idle-beat timer/arm + active dialogue scene/sub-index.

dialogue_intro.note: the opening-prologue dialogue: box-open/reveal counter/line row + standee 5 slide tween + the ESC skip-event box state.

benign.reason: engine leaves DAT_09643524 set after a submenu back-out (render is cursor_anim-gated); the port clears it at cursor_anim==0 for its input gate — no render/input effect (engine-quirks §102). Same benign mark retail_fields.json carries.

the agent-maintained CUMULATIVE LCG-draw counter (retail_fields.json src:rngcalls = the Frida agent's g_rng_count_total) has a per-SIDE ORIGIN: the port counts from process start, the retail counter from Frida hook-install — so its ABSOLUTE value is capture-origin-dependent (class-3 environmental), NOT a game global; comparing it cross-side compares origins, not logic (VERIFIED on the confirmed-1:1 house-firstcust-arrprobe --state view: raw rng matched 1498/1498 while absolute rngcalls read retail 0 vs port 1902+). The deterministic RNG value is the raw state `rng`; per-frame consumption COUNT is flow_diff --rng-drill's domain (a future per-frame-DELTA leaf could add it).
